docs.fchar: anything but the record terminator: the field body.

source:
## Records without greed: a field is any run of non-newline bytes —
## the terminator stays OUT of the body's class, so the field ends
## exactly where the record does. Fields may contain pipes, colons,
## any punctuation: the shape never needs to count them.
grammar LocalVars version "1.0.0" edition "v2" {
  nl = %x0A
  ws = %x20 / %x09
  pq = *ws
  ## anything but the record terminator: the field body.
  fchar = %x09 / %x20-10FFFF
  field = *fchar as field
  row = pq field pq nl
  table = *( row )

  entry main: table

  test {
    accept "a|b|c\n"
    accept "key: value | with pipes | everywhere\n"
    accept "single\n"
    reject "no terminator"
  }
}
